36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
138595: Anos is the reincarnation of the man who was feared as the Demon King of Tyranny 2,000 years ago. He is resolute, stalwart, and invincible. His absolute power instils a veritable self-confidence that is only surpassed by his ego.
138596: Misha is a student at Delzogade, the Demon King Academy. She quickly becomes friends with Anos after they meet. Her magic power is quite high among most students at Delzogade.
138598: Kanon is a hero that battles against Anos. He seems to have a mutual respect with Anos, with both of them understanding each other. Before Anos was slain by Kanon, Anos wished they could be friends in 2000 years, should they ever meet.
139557: The mother of reincarnated Anos. She cares for Anos, loving him constantly. She is married to Gusta. When Anos brings home Misha, Izabella is quick to jump the gun and assumes that Anos is together with Misha. She decides that is the case and supports it through and through.
139558: The homeroom teacher of the class Anos is in. Initially, Emilia holds no respect towards Anos; however, that changes after he proves himself to her.
